environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on a standard Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance running Puma behind nginx reverse proxy. The application runs as the 'deploy' user with standard filesystem permissions. No filename validation beyond null byte removal. The process has full access to the host filesystem. Nginx serves static files from public/ directory including uploaded content.

config.web_server: nginx 1.22 reverse proxy, serves /uploads/ as static
